title: Change one setting
story: prep_target.sh prepares one target, set by the TARGET= line near the top. It's set to {{old}}, but you need {{target}}. Edit that line, then run the script.
hints: `nano prep_target.sh` opens it. `$TARGET` later in the script uses whatever the TARGET= line says.
Change the line to `TARGET={{target}}` (no spaces around `=`), save with Ctrl+O, exit with Ctrl+X, then `./prep_target.sh`.
